function.name: create_claim
function.description: Create a new warranty/return claim record in the JOOLA CS system. Returns the human-readable claim_id (format WC-XXXXX) and the initial status_detail. Call this after evaluate_eligibility has returned PROCESSING or ELIGIBLE_FOR_DAMAGE_REVIEW, OR when the customer explicitly asks to open a case even on a NOT_ELIGIBLE decision (so a human can review). Always read the WC-XXXXX number back to the customer at the end.

customer_id.description: Internal customer UUID, if known from lookup_order.

customer_email.description: Customer email — required if customer_id is not known.

order_id.description: Internal order UUID, if found via lookup_order.

issue.description: Full description of the issue in plain language, suitable for a CS Lead to read.

is_defective.description: True for warranty / damage cases. False for change-of-mind returns.

decision.description: The decision returned by evaluate_eligibility (so the claim record is created already classified).

reason_code.description: Reason code returned by evaluate_eligibility (e.g., UNAUTHORIZED_SELLER, NFC_LATE, OK_NFC, OK_STANDARD).

sentiment.description: Optional sentiment score 0.00 - 1.00 estimated from the conversation tone.
